input.title: Unisex Donkey – Stubborn Is a Strong Word. Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

STUBBORN IS A STRONG WORD. is the donkey hoodie for the person who has dug in and calls it a position, worn on the farm, at the sanctuary and as a gift from anyone who has lost an argument to one.

STUBBORN IS runs across the top in heavy slab capitals and A STRONG / WORD. stacks in two huge lines below. Between them a storybook donkey sits down squarely on a dirt road with its front legs planted, ears up and a calm unbothered face, a slack lead rope on the dirt and a weathered fence post beside it.

Navy carries cream and mustard lettering with a cream edge around the road scene; Sand gets deep brown and rust lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this donkey hoodie warm enough for farm chores and cool mornings?
Yes. The Stubborn Is a Strong Word. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for farm chores, cool mornings and walks down a dirt road.

How does the Stubborn Is a Strong Word. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a donkey fan?
It is a natural one. Everyone knows a donkey that will not move, or a person who acts like one, so it lands with farm folks, sanctuary volunteers and the family member who never gives in. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the road scene sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Stubborn Is a Strong Word. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
